property_summary: For every admissible input, the reference contract's transfer(...) call completes and returns true; the mutant returns false for the same inputs, so the return value must be true for the reference but can be false in the mutant.

For every admissible input the reference contract's transfer(...) call returns true (completes and yields true); the mutant returns false for some inputs, so asserting the return is true distinguishes them.

For every call to transfer with any non-empty _tos and any callee address, the reference contract always performs all low-level calls for every element of _tos before returning (so a call that completes will only return after all iterations), whereas the mutant may return after the first iteration and thus can return earlier causing observable difference in whether the function completed all calls (we detect this by having the callee record how many calls it received and asserting that after transfer returns the callee saw exactly _tos.length calls).
